text:
julia: Heads-up — Quickplay Edge plugin sample is failing our eval harness on CI. Tests are skipping with "missing telemetry key" errors. Was working yesterday. Anyone seen this?

omar: Ugh, saw a flaky failure earlier too. I thought it was env-specific. Can you paste the CI log?

julia: pasted log below from the failing job: ```
ERROR: eval-runner: missing required telemetry: sample_id
Skipping 4 tests.
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/app/eval/runner.py", line 123, in run
    ensure_telemetry(ctx)
  File "/app/eval/utils.py", line 42, in ensure_telemetry
    raise RuntimeError('missing required telemetry: ' + key)
RuntimeError: missing required telemetry: sample_id
```

li: Quick note — the sample Edge plugin toggles opt-in telemetry at runtime and we recently changed the default to `opt_out` in the JS starter to avoid accidental PII. That might explain why CI (which uses the template) no longer sends `sample_id`.

julia: Ah that fits. But why would the eval harness error out instead of falling back? We only changed the sample to opt-out, not the harness.

omar: Harness expects a telemetry envelope. There's a small mismatch between the Node SDK and Python harness: Node sends `telemetry.session` when enabled, Python expects `telemetry.sample_id`. We added a compatibility shim in python-sdk last month but the harness in CI is pinned to older commit.

sam: @julia quick workaround: set env `QUICKPLAY_TELEMETRY=enable` in the CI job to restore previous behavior. But we should fix the starter + harness parity.

julia: adding that env made CI green locally. Not ideal as a long-term fix. We need either starter to provide a stable key or harness to be tolerant.

li: I can push a tiny patch to the starter that sets `sample_id` when `session` exists, so both fields are present. Patch: ```js
// quickplay edge plugin telemetry shim
const t = getTelemetry();
if (t.session && !t.sample_id) { t.sample_id = t.session.id || generateSampleId(); }
```
I'll open a PR.

sdk-bot: Note: JS SDK release 0.12.3 added `telemetry.session` semantics. Python SDK 0.9.1 added shim for `sample_id` -> `session` mapping. Check pinned versions in CI.

julia: Thanks. Also noticed a related thing — retry behavior for the embed endpoint in the sample app is noisy: 429s trigger immediate retries from browser client which creates thundering herd on Dedicated pools. Any thoughts on default client retry strategy?

omar: We historically shipped a very aggressive retry in the quickstarter client to make demos look resilient. That's probably the root cause. Should backoff + jitter be the default for front-end SDKs.

li: Agree. Small config idea for the sample app package.json scripts: ```json
"env": {
  "REDWOOD_RETRY_STRATEGY": "exponential_jitter",
  "REDWOOD_RETRY_MAX": "3"
}
```
Then client default respects that env at build time.

julia: That would also help cost during demos — fewer wasted requests. Can we get a follow-up ticket to: (1) shim telemetry fields in starter, (2) update dev CI pins to newer python-sdk or relax harness, (3) change default retry to exponential+jitter in frontend starter?

sam: I'll file the ticket under DEVEX backlog and assign to @li/@omar. Ticket draft: "quickplay: telemetry parity + sane retry defaults for starter and eval harness".

deploy-bot: deploy triggered: ci/edge-quickplay-starter — env patch applied (QUICKPLAY_TELEMETRY=enable) — build 4823 — passed. :white_check_mark:

julia: Ok thanks — holding until li's PR lands and we update CI pins. Leaving notes in the starter README about telemetry opt-in semantics to avoid future surprises. :memo:

omar: Also let's add a small unit test in the eval harness that tolerates either `session` or `sample_id` keys — should catch regressions early.

li: On it, will add unit + integration test.

julia: Excellent. Thanks team.
